task: logrotate config for api to daily logs with the date in the name
command:
printf '/var/log/api/*.log {
    daily
    rotate 30
    dateext
    compress
    delaycompress
    missingok
    notifempty
}
' | sudo tee /etc/logrotate.d/api
explanation: Check with logrotate -d.

task: logrotate config for api to keep two months of weekly logs
command:

    weekly

    compress
    delaycompress
    missingok
    notifempty
}
' | sudo tee /etc/logrotate.d/api

task: Label /srv/pgdata as postgresql_db_t permanently
command: sudo semanage fcontext -a -t postgresql_db_t "/srv/pgdata(/.*)?" && sudo restorecon -Rv /srv/pgdata
explanation: restorecon applies the rule.

task: Label /srv/samba as samba_share_t permanently
command: sudo semanage fcontext -a -t samba_share_t "/srv/samba(/.*)?" && sudo restorecon -Rv /srv/samba
explanation: restorecon applies the rule.

task: Label /srv/web as httpd_sys_content_t permanently

explanation: restorecon applies the rule.

task: Ticket: Backup job reports success but files are missing
explanation: Always test restores.

task: Ticket: Certificate expired warning in browser
explanation: Renew, reload web server, monitor expiry.

task: Ticket: Clock is wrong and Kerberos login fails
explanation: Fix NTP; Kerberos allows only 5 minutes skew.

task: Ticket: Cron job did not run
explanation: PATH, permissions or % escaping; docs/16-cron-scenarios.md.

task: Ticket: Docker host disk full
command: docker system df; docker system prune
explanation: Old images and logs; set log rotation in daemon.json.

task: Ticket: Domain names do not resolve
command: resolvectl status; dig ya.ru; dig @8.8.8.8 ya.ru
explanation: runbooks/dns-failure.md.

task: Ticket: High memory usage and OOM kills
command: free -h; ps aux --sort=-%mem | head; journalctl -k | grep -i oom
explanation: Find the leak, set MemoryMax, add swap if needed.

task: Ticket: Host unreachable alert from monitoring
command: ping host; ip neigh; ssh host; check console
explanation: Network, firewall or host down; escalate with facts.

task: Ticket: Login to directory account fails
command: realm list; systemctl status sssd; sudo sss_cache -E
explanation: SSSD cache or domain trust problem.

task: Ticket: No space left on device
command: df -h; df -i; sudo du -xh / --max-depth=2 | sort -h | tail; sudo lsof +L1
explanation: runbooks/disk-full.md.

task: Ticket: Package install fails with lock error (Ubuntu)
explanation: Wait for unattended-upgrades; never delete the lock blindly.

task: Ticket: Permission denied on a shared folder
explanation: Check groups, mode, ACL and SELinux context.

task: Ticket: Server is slow
explanation: Check load vs cores, IO wait and swap; runbooks/high-load.md.

task: Ticket: Server went into emergency mode after reboot
explanation: Usually a bad fstab line; docs/24-boot-recovery.md.

task: Ticket: Service fails to start after config change
command: systemctl status SERVICE; journalctl -u SERVICE -n 50; nginx -t
explanation: Validate config syntax and read the first error.

task: Ticket: Too many open files
command: systemctl show SERVICE -p LimitNOFILE; ls /proc/PID/fd | wc -l
explanation: Raise LimitNOFILE in a drop-in; docs/25-performance-tuning.md.

task: Ticket: User cannot SSH in
command: ssh -v user@host; sudo chage -l user; journalctl -u ssh -n 50
explanation: runbooks/ssh-access.md.

task: Ticket: Website returns 502 Bad Gateway
command: systemctl status nginx; journalctl -u nginx -n 50; ss -tlnp | grep -E ':80|:8080'
explanation: Backend is down or Nginx cannot reach it; see runbooks/service-down.md.
